cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: Congratulate Through Your Teeth
cards.instruction: Perform warm praise while allowing competitive resentment to intensify beneath every compliment.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Congratulations on beating my poem. Lovely to see the rhythm I taught you carrying so much of it.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Are you saying I didn't deserve the prize?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: No, you've come miles since I counted every beat for you. The judges even enjoyed that last line I asked you to change.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: That isn't much of a compliment.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: A wonderful first prize for my pupil. When you read it out, thank me for those rhythm lessons. Give my name the same care you gave that last line.

reason: Make the actual spoken request clearer on reread: remove staging-dependent resentment and detached closing flourishes, keep the established tuition, and distinguish physical from verbal rematch tactics.
